requirements.quote:
The extension_data field of the quic_transport_parameters extension
   defined in [QUIC-TLS] contains the QUIC transport parameters.  They
   are encoded as a sequence of transport parameters, as shown in
   Figure 20:
requirements.condition: When encoding the extension_data field of the quic_transport_parameters extension
requirements.required_behavior: Encode its contents as a sequence of QUIC transport parameters.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode non-transport-parameter content in place of the transport-parameter sequence.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's extension_data encoder can be inspected or tested to verify that it emits a sequence of transport parameters.

requirements.quote:
Each transport parameter is encoded as an (identifier, length, value)
   tuple, as shown in Figure 21:
requirements.required_behavior: Encode it as an identifier, length, value tuple in that order.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit, reorder, or add components of the transport parameter tuple.
requirements.why_checkable: Serialized transport parameters can be parsed to verify the presence and ordering of the identifier, length, and value components.

requirements.quote:
The Transport Parameter Length field contains the length of the
   Transport Parameter Value field in bytes.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the Transport Parameter Length field equal to the byte length of the Transport Parameter Value field.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a Transport Parameter Length that differs from the value field's byte length.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can compare the encoded length field with the actual number of bytes occupied by the corresponding value field.

requirements.quote:
QUIC encodes transport parameters into a sequence of bytes, which is
   then included in the cryptographic handshake.
requirements.condition: When transmitting QUIC transport parameters during connection establishment
requirements.required_behavior: Encode the transport parameters as a byte sequence and include that sequence in the cryptographic handshake.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not transmit the transport parameters outside the cryptographic handshake in place of including their encoded byte sequence in it.
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake construction and emitted handshake messages can be inspected to verify inclusion of the encoded transport-parameter byte sequence.
